description: This PHP file defines a class 'HeaderData' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\Header'. The class manages layout-related metadata for report headers, including columns and group counts, with methods to get, set, and increment these properties.

classes.name: HeaderData
classes.description: Manages header report data such as columns, group counts, and grouped columns for the OrangeHRM reporting system.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the array of column objects, which can include 'StackedColumn' or 'Column' instances.

methods.name: setColumns
methods.description: Sets the array of column objects used in the header.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of columns.

methods.name: setColumnCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of columns.

methods.name: incrementColumnCount
methods.description: Increments the column count by a specified number (default is 1).

methods.name: getGroupCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of groups.

methods.name: setGroupCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of groups.

methods.name: incrementGroupCount
methods.description: Increments the group count by a specified number (default is 1).

methods.name: getGroupedColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of grouped columns.

methods.name: setGroupedColumnCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of grouped columns.

methods.name: incrementGroupedColumnCount
methods.description: Increments the count of grouped columns by a specified number (default is 1).
